title: Dedicated mrLAE Authenticated Encryption with Minimal Expansion
summary: Generic SIVAT composition achieves misuse resistance but adds message expansion; constructing a dedicated mrLAE-secure scheme with minimal expansion remains open.

formal_statement.body: Misuse resistance can be achieved through the generic MAC-then-Encrypt-then-MAC construction SIVAT, but at the cost of additional message expansion. Construct a dedicated authenticated-encryption scheme that achieves $\mathrm{mrLAE}$ security with minimal message expansion.

scope.domain: Authenticated encryption involving generic SIVAT composition and dedicated constructions targeting mrLAE security.
parameters: Message expansion — the efficiency quantity to minimize
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a dedicated authenticated-encryption scheme achieving mrLAE security with minimal message expansion.

citations.label: Authenticated Encryption in the Face of Protocol and Side Channel Leakage

progress.summary: The source presents generic SIVAT composition as achieving misuse resistance at the cost of additional message expansion. It identifies a dedicated mrLAE-secure construction with minimal expansion as an unresolved goal.
citation_labels: Guy Barwell et al., Authenticated Encryption in the Face of Protocol and Side Channel Leakage
